name: Rao-Ji
source:
Rao-Ji is a fiore (futanari), and although she is somewhat shy by nature, she is seemingly blessed with an incredibly large libido, a fact which puzzles the nobles and scholars in Alabast. She can sometimes suffer as a result of being entirely too pent up. Although embarrassed by the act itself, Rao-Ji is very needy, having several orgasms in a very short time frame, making her a favorite among the nobles. Who seem to adore her stamina and the “volume” of her orgasms. When it’s not the nobles who are enjoying company with Rao-Ji she speaks to other servants and slaves within the Menagerie, who comfort the Drachene and also help her learn more about herself.
